user.title: Choose a BLE device
user.description: Nearby FD50 devices are shown. Discovery alone does not prove compatibility: select your A1 Ultra lock.

credentials.title: Your lock credentials
credentials.description: Enter your own lock credentials from Tuya Developer Platform; see INSTALL.md. The installed Tuya integration does not import keys automatically. Connection verification does not operate the motor.

error.invalid_credentials: Check the credential fields and the Base64 BLE unlock check.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot verify the connection. Check credentials, Bluetooth range and disconnect the phone from the lock.

abort.no_unconfigured_devices: No new FD50 devices found. Wake the lock, check HA Bluetooth and retry.

init.title: A1 Ultra BLE
init.description: Maintain the BLE session and reconnect after disconnection.
